content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICMR NIHR Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR NIHR Junior Consultant (Medical) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the ICMR-National Institute of Health Research, Bhubaneswar (ICMR NIHR) for filling up temporary research positions in Odisha.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The post announced under this recruitment notification is Junior Consultant (Medical) under the research department category.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Consultant (Medical) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for ICMR NIHR Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection is conducted through a walk-in interview process which includes document verification, written test/assignment if necessary, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 29 September 2026 at the designated center in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Consultant (Medical) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 80,000.00.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS, BDS, BVSc, or equivalent degree in a relevant subject along with at least 6 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants ranges between 40 to 50 years, with relaxations applicable as per established government rules.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview or applying for this post.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Annex Building of ICMR-National Institute of Health Research, located in Chandrasekharpur, Bhubaneswar, Odisha, with pincode 751023.
